[Thorough] Parallel Deep Research (30s - 25 minutes)

Part of [`seek research`](seek-research.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research parallel [options] <query...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query...` | Yes, one or more | Research question or objective |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--schema <path>` | Path to a JSON file describing the desired output schema (object with properties). |  |
| `--processor <name>` | Processor depth: core-fast \| core \| core2x-fast \| core2x \| pro-fast \| pro \| ultra-fast \| ultra | `"core"` |
| `--async` | Submit the research job and return without polling | `false` |
| `--json` | Emit JSON (raw result when blocking; lifecycle envelope with --async) |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek research parallel` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek research parallel --help`:

```text
Usage: seek research parallel [options] <query...>

[Thorough] Parallel Deep Research (30s - 25 minutes)

Arguments:
  query               Research question or objective

Options:
  --schema <path>     Path to a JSON file describing the desired output schema
                      (object with properties).
  --processor <name>  Processor depth: core-fast | core | core2x-fast | core2x |
                      pro-fast | pro | ultra-fast | ultra  (default: "core")
  --async             Submit the research job and return without polling
                      (default: false)
  --json              Emit JSON (raw result when blocking; lifecycle envelope
                      with --async)
  -h, --help          display help for command

`-fast` processors prioritize quicker results at the expense of freshness of data:
	core-fast (15s-100s)
	pro-fast (30s-5m)
	ultra-fast (1-10m)
	core (60s-5m)
	core2x (60s-10m)
	pro (3-9m)
	ultra (5-25m)

core: Cross-referenced, moderately complex outputs
core2x: High complexity cross referenced outputs
pro: Exploratory web research
ultra: Advanced multi-source deep research
```
